text:
Can you name the 7 main structures of the posterior mediastinum? 🧠 on the DATE, Vivian Slapped Larry
Posterior mediastinum mnemonic: DATE VSL = 7 main structures
D = Descending thoracic aorta
A = Azygos and hemiazygos veins
T = Thoracic duct
E = Esophagus
V = Vagus nerves
S = Splanchnic nerves
L = Lymph nodes
Quick test: which one is the only major artery on the list? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Figs. 1032 and 530, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
